note: The Central Bank of Montenegro's Decision on Credit Registry, passed by its Council on 15 September 2026 (OGM 138/26 by the file's name), in the Bank's English translation linked from its regulations page (cbcg.me/en/about-us/legislation/regulations), read in full; it repealed the Decision of 2018 (OGM 39/18, 18/19) on entering into force on the eighth day after publication. Article 2: the Credit Registry is a single electronic database of individual persons' indebtedness, maintained by the Central Bank. Article 6(3): lenders submit the outstanding-indebtedness data once a month, within ten days after the month ends, and that monthly data carries the regularity of repayment (debt status, past due days, overdue principal and interest; Article 10): written as reported 30 days after the due date (a monthly cycle, no threshold stated). Article 13(6): lenders have access to the Registry's historical data on indebtedness for the preceding three years from the latest available date: written as keep 3, the game's reading that a late payment older than three years no longer shows to a lender (the Decision sets no deletion rule; Article 5 has a debt reported until it is repaid or collection ends). No shorter period for a paid debt is set, so clears isn't used.

sources.title: Central Bank of Montenegro: Decision on Credit Registry (Council, 15 September 2026), English translation
sources.said: the Council of the Central Bank of Montenegro, at its meeting held on 15 September 2026, passed the following ... (1) Credit Registry shall be a unified and standardised electronic database containing information on the indebtedness of individual persons towards the reporting entities referred to in Article 3 of this Decision (hereinafter: “indebtedness”), maintained by the Central Bank of Montenegro ... 1) KR data once a month, and no later than ten days following the expiry of the reporting month; ... 3) data on the regularity of debt repayment (debt status, past due days, overdue unpaid principal, overdue unpaid interest, ... (6) Reporting entities referred to in Article 3 paragraph (1) of this Decision shall have access to historical Credit Registry data on indebtedness for the preceding three years, calculated from the latest available date to which such data relate. ... As of the day of entry into force of this Decision, the Decision on Credit Registry (OGM 39/18, 18/19) shall be repealed.
